Lemma
[Monotonicity formula for the classical entropy] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0399 ↗ def:chow-ii-appd-perelman-energy-entropy 1. appD:D.33\group Perelman Invariants

Suppose $(g(t),f(t))$ obeys the coupled energy evolution on a closed manifold, and set $\mathcal N=\int f e^{-f}\, d\mu $. Then \[ \mathcal F(g(t),f(t))\leq \frac n{2(T-t)}\int e^{-f}\, d\mu \] and \[ \frac d{dt}\left(\mathcal N- \frac n2\left(\int e^{-f}\, d\mu \right)\log (T-t)\right)\geq 0. \]
